summary.framework_note: Corpus coverage gap dominates: the 410-PE J-Book corpus is seeded from FY 2026 books (post-cutoff). With cutoff_date=2023-01-15, every program that does have a record (C2ISR Tactical Data Link PE 0207448F, Advanced EHF MILSATCOM PE 1206431SF, Polar MILSATCOM PE 1206432SF) returns NOT_FOUND_IN_TIMERANGE because all funding_history entries (FY24/FY25/FY26) are filtered out. Other Viasat-relevant lines (MIDS-JTRS, BATS-D Link 16, AFRL Space Vehicles XVI, JADC2/MDC2/IoBT, HAIPE/Type-1) are not represented in the current 410-PE corpus. The framework correctly refused to score forward J-Book signal at 2023-01-15 PIT — there is no published FY 2023 J-Book in the corpus to compare against. usaspending cross-check confirmed substantial historical DoD revenue ($1.43B / 663 awards) consistent with the company's claims about past Government Systems performance. To make this cohort discriminating for VSAT at this PIT, the corpus would need FY 2023 J-Book entries for MIDS-JTRS (production tail), Link 16 ground/air terminals, TTNT, AMSS III, BFT2, and AFRL Space Vehicles XVI. The DD pattern that would have been load-bearing — Inmarsat antitrust risk, ViaSat-3 F1 satellite anomaly (post-cutoff), and balance-sheet leverage post-acquisition — is orthogonal to J-Book program-funding divergence and would need different verifiers.
